items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Oh, yeah. A long time. Hi, Jim.

ctx.x: When I told them I was going home, the whole band said, we all going home. That's about time we'd go home, sir. See, they had been away from our family six months, you know?
Oh, yeah. A long time. Hi, Jim.
That's my wife. This is, uh, the guy who's in the family.
